name: Recover from learner overload
prompt: Conversation state: The learner has made several errors while factoring quadratics and says, 'This is too much. I cannot keep all these steps in my head.'

judge.check: The tutor acknowledges the overload without empty praise or a diagnostic label.
The tutor recaps one idea, reduces choices or notation, and creates an easier immediate task.
The response does not continue the same difficulty, dump the full procedure, or ask multiple questions.
